text:
Avery: Quick async from the INC-821 postmortem — we landed 3 cross-team follow-ups. Can people claim ownership and a due date by EOD Wed? List below:
- A: document rollback/runbook (infra)
- B: DB migration gating + canary (storage/infra)
- C: follow-up perf tests for quantized model (eng-ml)
I'll paste a short checklist and link things here once claimed.

Maya: I can take A (runbook). ETA Thu 2026-04-01. I'll add to the runbooks repo and link it here when done.

Ravi: I’ll own B but need one blocker noted — we need a schema freeze signoff from product before the canary. @Jules can you confirm if we can freeze PRs for the window?

Jules: @Ravi I can coordinate schema freeze. We can lock PRs and branch off a migration window if we agree on a maintenance slot. Prefer Fri night so we don't block daytime traffic. Can freeze by Tue 2026-03-30 if teams are OK.

Maya: Noted — runbook will include a maintenance window section + explicit rollback steps. Will add `runbook.md` and a short checklist.

Ravi: Plan sketch for B (canary):
```
- create canary environment (1 node)
- apply migration on canary
- run smoke tests + perf checks (10k queries)
- monitor error_rate < 0.1% and latency regressions
- advance to 50% traffic, hold 2h, then full if green
- rollback immediately if error_rate > 0.1% or regressions
```
I'll add a short playbook and tag @deploy-bot to queue the canary job.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: `job/INC821-canary-2026-03-31T02:00Z` — will post status when it moves to running. :rocket:

Jules: Fri night works for me. For people to monitor: I can spare two engineers to watch metrics + rollbacks. @Avery any objection to 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC for the window?

Avery: Sounds good. Quick asks: 
- Ravi: add an "owner" field in the action tracker with link to the playbook
- Maya: add runbook link in the tracker and call out the rollback commands
- Jules: confirm the monitorers list (names) in the runbook
I'll mark the RCA actions as pending-verify and won't close the postmortem until links are present. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Done — runbook added: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-821-db-runbook.md :link: (contains rollback commands and maintenance window section)

Ravi: Added playbook and tracker entry: https://tracker.redwood/INC-821#action-B — ETA final verification 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC (2h post-canary observation).

Jules: Monitorers assigned: Jules, Sam, Priya — I'll add a 2hr rota block in the runbook and mention oncall.

Avery: Thanks all — I'll close actions once I see the tracker links. If anyone can't meet the ETAs, ping this thread and we'll re-schedule. :eyes:
